`backend-execution-plan` declares 5 permission(s) but `backend-execution-plan` carries no `BOOTSTRAP DATA` section — the module plans its structure and its behaviour and nothing at all about the data that must exist before either can work

7 of 11 `API` blocks name no `ENT` (API-MDL-001, API-MDL-004, API-MDL-005, API-MDL-007, API-MDL-008, API-MDL-009 …), so an operation that resolves to none of them cannot be told apart from one that was never built — the demand each `SCR-REQ` declares stays unchecked until every block carries the subject its own template requires

`API-MDL-001` is stated as `GET /lookup-types`, which `api-docs` does not publish — the published surface serves `POST /api/v1/mdl/lookup-types`. The published surface is the authority; correct the row, or record the divergence at the row rather than only in an ADR

`API-MDL-005` is stated as `GET /lookup-types/{id}/values`, which `api-docs` does not publish — the published surface serves `POST /api/v1/mdl/lookup-types/{id}/values`. The published surface is the authority; correct the row, or record the divergence at the row rather than only in an ADR

`API-MDL-010` is stated as `GET /lookup-types/by-owner`, which `api-docs` does not publish — no published endpoint matches that path at all. The published surface is the authority; correct the row, or record the divergence at the row rather than only in an ADR
`test-execution-manifest` is missing or empty
`US-MDL-005` is covered by 1 requirement(s) and none states an `unwanted` path — what the system does when the input, state or sequence is wrong is unspecified for this feature
